# name: # arguments of calls and beta-redexes, by-need alternatives only for bound
an unbound match-shaped definition is an ordinary call
a bound case definition takes its alternatives by need
an unbound copy of a case definition takes closures
a dead beta-redex argument is still evaluated
a beta-redex argument is not re-evaluated under a closure
a closure argument is built once, before the body
a closed lambda argument is substituted
